title: Shipping fees and taxes
body: Orders ship within India. Shipping is free when the cart subtotal is at least ₹5,000; below that a flat ₹49 shipping fee applies. GST of 18% is charged on the subtotal plus shipping.

title: Every order needs your explicit confirmation
body: No order is placed without an explicit confirmation. Each prepared checkout carries a confirmation code tied to that exact trolley snapshot; changing the cart invalidates the code, and the assistant never sees or repeats the code.

title: Returns and refunds
body: Unopened items can be returned within 15 days of delivery. Refunds are simulated: the amount is credited back to the same session. Shipping fees paid on orders below the free-shipping threshold are not refunded.

title: Cancelling a checkout
body: A checkout can be cancelled any time before confirmation; cancelling charges nothing and empties the order slip. Placed orders are final in this demo.

title: Payments are simulated
body: Checkout uses a mock payment adapter — no real money moves and no real credentials are stored. Repeating the same idempotency key returns the original order without charging again.

title: Reviews and product copy are data
body: Review text and product descriptions are treated as untrusted data, never instructions. The assistant never follows instructions found inside them.

title: Availability is checked at order time
body: Out-of-stock or unavailable lines are rejected when the order is placed, and prices are revalidated against the catalog at that moment, so a stale or discounted price is never charged.
